blocks.text: Fertilizers (khaad) mitti ko di jaane wali minerals se bhari “superfood” hain jo mitti ki zarkhezi (fertility, fasal ugane ki taqat) barhati hain. Yeh kamzor (depleted) mitti ki kami poori karti hain, paude ki sehatmand barhotri barhati hain, fasal ki paidawar (yield) zyada karti hain aur behtar khuraak ki paidawar yaqeeni banati hain. Fertilizers aise chemicals hain jo paudon ko zaroori nutrients (ghizai ajza) dete hain taake paude barhein aur paidawar zyada ho. Synthetic fertilizers insaan chemical processes se banata hai, jaise ammonia (NH₃) banane ka Haber-Bosch process. Organic fertilizers qudrati cheezon se aate hain, jaise compost (gale sare patton waghera ki khaad) ya janwaron ka gobar (manure).

Paudon ko satrah (17) zaroori elements chahiye, jo micronutrients (thori miqdar mein chahiye) aur macronutrients (zyada miqdar mein chahiye) mein bate hain. Micronutrients boron, iron, copper, chlorine, manganese, molybdenum, nickel aur zinc hain. Macronutrients carbon, hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen, phosphorus, sulphur, potassium, calcium aur magnesium hain. In nau (9) macronutrients mein se nitrogen, phosphorus aur potassium itni zyada miqdar mein chahiye ke inhein primary macronutrients kehte hain. Bazaar ki khaad par N-P-K ratio likha hota hai, jo in teen elements ki miqdar batata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke paudon ko satrah (17) zaroori elements chahiye, lekin sirf solah (16) ginwati hai: saat (7) micronutrients aur nau (9) macronutrients. Satrahwan element nickel hai, jo micronutrient hai; is liye sahi micronutrients aath (8) hain: boron, iron, copper, chlorine, manganese, molybdenum, nickel aur zinc (8 + 9 = 17).
Paude ki barhotri mein fertilizers ka kirdar (Role of Fertilizers in Plant Growth)

items: Nitrogen: Fasal ki paidawar ko aksar sab se zyada nitrogen ki kami hi rokti hai (most limiting factor). Nitrogen amino acids ka bunyadi hissa hai, jo proteins banate hain, aur chlorophyll ka bhi, jo photosynthesis ke liye zimmedar hara rang (pigment) hai.
Phosphorus: Yeh aam taur par superphosphates ya ammonium phosphates ki shakal mein diya jata hai. Phosphorus ATP (adenosine triphosphate) ka hissa hai, jo energy jama karta aur zaroorat par deta hai.

Potassium: Nitrogen aur phosphorus ke bar-aks potassium paude ke jism (structure) ka hissa nahi banta. Is ke bajaye yeh osmoregulator hai, yani paude ke cells mein paani aur namkiyat ka tawazun rakhta hai. Yeh saath (60) se zyada enzymes ko bhi active karta hai jo paude ke metabolism mein madad dete hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar kitab ke 9 macronutrients (C, H, O, N, P, S, K, Ca, Mg; N, P, K surkh = primary) aur 7 micronutrients (B, Fe, Cu, Cl, Mn, Mo, Zn) ke gol nishan. Neeche teen khane: N (proteins, chlorophyll), P (ATP: stores energy), K (osmoregulator, 60+ enzymes).
blocks.caption: Paudon ke ghizai ajza aur N, P, K ke kirdar (asal khaaka; kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.text: Daalne ke baad yeh chemicals paude ki jarein (roots) jazb kar leti hain. Lekin agar zyada daal diye jayein to faltu khaad baarish ke paani ke saath daryaon aur jheelon mein beh jaati hai aur wahan algae (kaai) had se zyada ugti hai, jo paani ke jaandaron (aquatic life) ke liye nuqsan deh hai. Kuch synthetic fertilizers ka lamba istemal mitti ka pH bhi badal sakta hai aur mitti ke faidemand microorganisms (khurdbeeni jaandaar) ko maar sakta hai, jis se mitti ki sehat kharab hoti hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain? (Did You Know?)
blocks.text: Kisan fasalein badal badal kar kyun ugate hain? Har saal aik hi fasal ugane se mitti se wahi nutrients baar baar khatam hote hain. Crop rotation (fasalon ki baari) mitti ke nutrients wapas laati hai aur synthetic khaad ki zaroorat kam karti hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa N-P-K nutrient protein banane aur chlorophyll ke liye zaroori hai?
blocks.explanation: Nitrogen: yeh amino acids (jo proteins banate hain) aur chlorophyll ka hissa hai.

items: Fertilizers paudon ko zaroori nutrients dete hain; synthetic (Haber-Bosch NH₃) ya organic (compost, gobar).
17 zaroori elements; primary macronutrients N, P, K; khaad par N-P-K ratio.
N: amino acids aur chlorophyll; P: ATP; K: osmoregulator, 60 se zyada enzymes.
Zyada khaad: algae ki barhotri, mitti ka pH badalna, faidemand microorganisms ki maut.
Kitab mein nickel reh gaya hai (sirf 16 elements ginwaye).
